description: This file defines interfaces and constants for controlling GPIO functions on the AXP192 PMIC within the Zephyr RTOS environment. It includes enum definitions, macros, and function prototypes for GPIO configuration, reading, and writing.

methods.name: mfd_axp192_gpio_func_ctrl
methods.description: Configures a specific GPIO pin (0..4) on the AXP192 to a designated function, such as input, output, ADC, PWM, etc.

methods.name: mfd_axp192_gpio_func_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration of a specific GPIO pin.

methods.name: mfd_axp192_gpio_pd_ctrl
methods.description: Enables or disables the pull-down resistor on GPIO3 or GPIO4.

methods.name: mfd_axp192_gpio_pd_get
methods.description: Gets the current pull-down status of a GPIO pin.

methods.name: mfd_axp192_gpio_read_port
methods.description: Reads the current value of the GPIO port.

methods.name: mfd_axp192_gpio_write_port
methods.description: Writes a value to the GPIO port with a specified mask.
